reported_success.quote: An Unsuccessful Preregistered Replication of the Effect of Product Size on Status Signaling

notes: Both assigned Cohen d records have identical descriptions and locators. No contrast assigned from audit ID or input order. Original PDF p. 6 (web P5): large-small t(182)=4.66, p=.001, d=1.10; large-medium t(182)=2.95, p=.01, d=.65; medium-small t(182)=2.27, p=.05, d=.46. Replication p. 6 Table 3: large-small t(412)=-0.77, p=.442, d=-0.10; large-medium t(412)=-0.90, p=.367, d=-0.10; medium-small t(412)=0.11, p=.916, d=0.01. These are candidate tests, not assigned extracted values. Table 3 also contains recalculated original d values in a separate column; they were not substituted for the originally printed d values. Replication Table 3 values differ from its abstract; only the supplied table locator was considered for candidates. Replication analysis uses all 415 participants without exclusion, but the target contrast remains unidentified. Original Method reports N=183 without explicitly documenting test-specific analytic N. Original supplied p. 5 versus located contrast PDF p. 6 reflects a cover-page/version pagination discrepancy; both were inspected. Original title verified in primary author-hosted PDF; saved web parse is an excerpt of the full PDF.
